sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for explaining the cost drivers behind your offer; we value our long-standing relationship and understand that larger price steps need committee approval. Our fixed volume covers our full demand for this part, placed entirely with you, and the longer contract term plus our rising forecast offer planning security; could you review the base price and alloy surcharge with your pricing committee?

We confirm a binding volume of 23700 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, fixed price, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We welcome your commitment to a 36-month term and can accept the requested 45-day payment terms. However, for a contract of this length, we are unable to fix the price and must include the AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Acknowledging the recent index developments you cited, we can offer a revised price of €5.40 per unit. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
